reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_pending_requests` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_pending_requests`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The pending-requests metric is emitted only under the new name envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_pending_requests, so monitoring that references the old per-node name will no longer receive data for it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries that reference envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_pending_requests to use envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_pending_requests.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_pending_requests is renamed to envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_pending_requests, so it is no longer exposed under the old per-node name.
